change_record.title: MarkFutureUpdateEquivalent attribute added to register equivalent updates on site install

description.excerpt: The attribute Drupal\Core\Update\Attribute\MarkFutureUpdateEquivalent has been added to make it possible to register hook_update_N implementations as equivalent during module install. Previously, registering updates as equivalent was only possible during module updates, because hook_update_N implementations do not run on module install. Applying the MarkFutureUpdateEquivalent attribute to the hook_update_N function will the register equivalent updates during both module install and update. The hook_update_N itself can be a no-op. If your site uses Drupal\Core\Update\UpdateHookRegistry::markFut
